text:
Evie: Quick preflight for Friday's 11am PT webinar — final pass on reg page, Zoom settings, recording handoff, and post-event follow-up. Who's taking what?

Joel: I can own recording + handoff. Zoom checklist I'm planning: enable cloud recording (speaker + gallery), enable audio transcript, add co-host @Evie, alternate host @Joel, disable join-before-host, require registration.

Ana: I'm on the reg page copy + form mapping. Need confirmation on required fields: email, company, job title, use case (short). Also confirm UTM params to capture and HubSpot form ID. Tagging as `webinar_serving_inference_0326`.

Sam: I'll own clips and social snippets. Plan: 3x 30–60s clips (product highlight, benchmark stat, CTA). Where will raw recording land so we can start edits ASAP? Also need captions.

Joel: Recording flow: Zoom cloud recording will auto-transcribe. After session ends I will: 1) Download cloud recording + transcript 2) Upload to S3 at `s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-26-serving-inference/raw/` 3) Ping Sam with links.

Joel: Quick command reminders for upload (manual):
```
# after download
aws s3 cp "LocalZoomRecording.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-26-serving-inference/raw/"
aws s3 cp "LocalZoomAudio.m4a" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-26-serving-inference/raw/"
```

Evie: Thanks. Also: enable auto-transcription in Zoom settings and check language is English (US). Please enable segment - speaker view + gallery recording so Sam has b-roll.

Ana: HubSpot mapping draft (for ops):
```
- hs_form_id: 98765
- fields: [email, firstname, lastname, company, job_title, use_case, utm_source, utm_campaign]
- lead_owner_assignment: round_robin(marketing_pool)
- contact_tag: webinar_serving_inference_0326
```
I'll drop the actual form ID in an update.

Sam: For clips: can you include timestamps for the 3 clips in the edited file? I can do captions myself but prefer SRT from Zoom as a starting point. Also request raw transcript in .txt.

ZoomBot: Recording started by host Joel at 11:01 AM PT.

Evie: Post-event cadence (proposed):
- 1h after: replay email with short 1‑paragraph summary + link to full recording (private link), CTA to book demo
- 24h after: highlights/clips email + social push (clips + 1 key stat)
- 48h after: full edited recording + transcript + blog summary (long-form)
- 72h: captions + asset library complete, close loop to SDRs with qualified leads list

Joel: Timelines acked. I will upload raw files within 2 hours of event end and set S3 perms to marketing-team. Will also create a Drive folder for editors with links.

Ana: Draft replay email copy (short):
"Thanks for joining! If you missed anything, watch the full recording here. Highlights: how we cut inference costs by 3x with batching, routing policy examples, Q&A. Book a demo."

Sam: For social, can we prioritize the benchmark stat: "3x cost reduction" as a clip hook. Also request 16:9 and 9:16 renders.

Evie: Owners: Reg page & tracking = Ana; Zoom host + raw upload = Joel; Clips + editing = Sam; Post-event email cadence + replay copy = Evie/Ana. Deadline: assets live or uploaded by 48h.

Joel: Will add co-host and alt-host now, toggles set. Double-check: Zoom setting "Only authenticated users can join" — we should keep it OFF to avoid friction for registrants.

Ana: Done on the reg page: HubSpot form draft published to staging. Please test registration flow (submit with test@redwood.com) and confirm UTM capture.

Evie: I'll run a quick test at 3pm PT. If anyone hits issues, drop in this thread. Thanks all :rocket:

ZoomBot: Recording ended at 12:09 PM PT. Cloud recording available: https://zoom.us/rec/share/EXAMPLE_LINK (access restricted).
